Directory research 2026-10-04: His website is shared with his band Yellowfly (yellowfly.net); I used the 'About Erich' page as his website. The social links on that site belong to the band, so they are not recorded as his: Facebook https://www.facebook.com/Yellowfly-219527384805406/, YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@YellowflyMusic (includes his solo videos), Spotify (Yellowfly) https://open.spotify.com/artist/3M1irXKWehQhf6SwH9Gs48. A Spotify artist 'Erich Glaubitz' (https://open.spotify.com/artist/3yChBgc2bLCWoL9A2KUOQs) holds TV/production library music, likely his writing work, not his live act; not recorded. The contact email is the Yellowfly Gmail on the site's contact page (a band/business contact he publishes). Both photos are older images from his site (the portrait looks decades old); the gallery is mostly Yellowfly band shots. No logo for the solo act (Yellowfly has one).
description: Long Island singer and guitarist who plays solo shows at restaurants, bars and wineries, covering standards, Motown and R&B, 50s and 60s rock and later pop and rock hits. He also fronts the rock band Yellowfly.
